author: BoxOfChocolate2
body:
Recently, on November 24, I, BoxOfChocolate2, was banned from Avicus for AimBot. I was not using it, yet I was still banned because of a player who reported me without any reason. I believe he was upset that I had killed him. I have no history of hacking and/or cheating on Avicus of any other servers. Thank you for reading and considering my appeal.

- BoxOfChocolate2

P.S. Avicus is my favorite server and I would really love to be able to play it again
